exposure: history of schizophrenia in first-degree relatives
childhood trauma (emotional abuse, emotional neglect, physical abuse, sexual abuse)
substance abuse (other than nicotine) at psychosis onset
cohort: The study included 118 stable outpatients diagnosed with schizophrenia.
finding: SCZ-D was associated with male sex and birth weight <3000 g, while SCZ-ND was associated with substance abuse at psychosis onset.
